name: Lonnie
method: Claude Sonnet 5.5 read the public Kaggle profile page and the public Competitions page with the Claude desktop app's built-in browser pane (one tab, no other browser) on 2026-10-30, waiting about six seconds after each load and five seconds between the two pages. Page text was read, the medal icons were read from the page (alt text on each medal image, cross-checked against screenshots of the list), and the avatar image address was read from the profile picture element. No rate limit, captcha or block appeared. This replaces an earlier draft written while Kaggle was blocking: none of that draft was carried over except the facts it cited from the existing record, which are re-sourced below or listed as unverified.

portrait.note: The stored 320px portrait is the same picture as the current Kaggle profile picture shown on https://www.kaggle.com/lonnieqin (the large round avatar in the profile header, 400px original). It was compared by eye against the downloaded original resized to 320px: same composition, a Ghibli-style illustrated head-and-shoulders portrait of one person with dark hair, round glasses, green shirt and backpack, a lamp post and brick street behind. It is Lonnie's own chosen profile picture (an illustration, not a photo), not a group image and not the grey default avatar. The existing file was kept and not overwritten; no -v2 file was made.
